reason: In src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_events_stats.py:209-222, _get_event_stats calls is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects with the enclosing dataset and raw request instead of its scoped_dataset and query parameters, and src/sentry/api/helpers/error_upsampling.py:103-139 checks that dataset (returning False for metrics) and request.GET.get('query', '').
